content: Joydeep Paul is a Frontend Developer specializing in React.js and modern web development. He is based in Asansol, West Bengal, India. Email: joydeeprnp8821@gmail.com. Portfolio: paulhere.netlify.app. GitHub username: joydeep-07. GitHub profile: github.com/joydeep-07. LinkedIn profile: linkedin.com/in/joydeep-paul-06b37926. Instagram: @mr.paul_16. He also maintains professional and personal projects through his portfolio and GitHub.

Joydeep Paul is a Frontend Developer from Asansol, West Bengal, India, focused primarily on React.js and modern frontend engineering. He works with JavaScript, TypeScript, React.js, Tailwind CSS, GSAP, Framer Motion, Redux Toolkit, React Router and other modern web technologies. He also has working knowledge of Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB, Supabase and REST API development. Joydeep enjoys building responsive, interactive and visually polished web applications. His development approach focuses on reusable components, clean code, responsive design, performance, usability and smooth user experiences. He is currently pursuing an MCA and is developing his skills toward becoming a stronger full-stack/MERN developer.

Joydeep Paul specializes in frontend development with React.js. He builds responsive, modern and interactive web applications using reusable component architecture and modern JavaScript practices. His frontend stack includes React.js, JavaScript ES6+, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Redux Toolkit, React Router, GSAP and Framer Motion. He has experience integrating REST APIs, managing application state, creating responsive layouts, implementing animations and optimizing frontend performance. He also has working knowledge of Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB, Supabase, authentication and backend API development. His development focus includes clean code, maintainability, responsive design, usability, performance and user experience.

Joydeep's core web technologies include JavaScript ES6+, TypeScript, HTML5 and CSS3. JavaScript is his primary programming language for frontend development. He has working knowledge of TypeScript and uses modern JavaScript concepts for React application development.

Joydeep's primary frontend framework is React.js. He works with React Hooks, Redux Toolkit, Context API, React Router, reusable components and modular component architecture. His styling and UI technologies include Tailwind CSS and Bootstrap. For animation and interaction, he works with GSAP, GSAP ScrollTrigger and Framer Motion. He focuses on responsive layouts, component reusability, application state management, smooth interactions and modern user interfaces.

Joydeep has working knowledge of backend development using Node.js and Express.js. He can build and integrate REST APIs and work with MongoDB and Supabase. His backend-related knowledge includes API development, authentication, authorization, JSON-based communication, Bearer token authentication and CRUD operations. His overall MERN knowledge covers MongoDB, Express.js, React.js and Node.js.

Joydeep uses Git and GitHub for version control and project management. His development tools include VS Code, Vite, NPM and Postman. He has experience deploying frontend projects using Netlify and Vercel and backend services using platforms such as Render. He works with environment variables, API configuration, CORS, debugging and deployment workflows. He also focuses on responsive behavior, cross-browser compatibility and frontend performance.

Joydeep worked as a Frontend Developer Intern at Unified Mentors from March 2026 to June 2026 for approximately three months. During the internship, he developed responsive React.js interfaces using modular and reusable hook-based components. He worked in an Agile environment alongside UI designers and backend engineers. His responsibilities included REST API integration, client-side state management, responsive UI development, debugging, reducing unnecessary component re-renders, performance optimization and resolving cross-browser and cross-device interface issues.

Joydeep has worked as a Contractual Computer Instructor at Kendriya Vidyalaya. His responsibilities include computer-related teaching and supporting office and academic work. This is a contractual role rather than a permanent position. Alongside this work, he continues developing his software engineering and frontend development skills.

NeuroCare is a MERN-based AI-powered healthcare and doctor appointment platform developed as a major project. It is designed around patients, doctors and administrators. The platform uses React.js, Redux Toolkit, Tailwind CSS, GSAP, Framer Motion, Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB, Groq API and Cloudinary. It includes role-based access control, Email OTP authentication, Google OAuth, doctor discovery based on illness and location, AI-powered doctor recommendations, preventive healthcare guidance, medical history, prescription PDF generation and an administrator-controlled appointment workflow. The appointment process follows a Request -> Admin Review/Approval -> Confirmation model so doctors do not directly receive unapproved appointment requests.

Joydeep's personal developer portfolio is built with React.js and modern frontend technologies. The website includes Home, About, Projects and Contact sections and showcases his skills, experience and projects. It uses Tailwind CSS, React Router, GSAP, ScrollTrigger, Framer Motion and Lenis for styling, routing, animation and smooth scrolling. Supabase is used for dynamic data such as messages, reviews and subscribers. The portfolio also includes an AI chatbot connected to a separate Node.js and Express backend. The frontend is deployed on Netlify and the backend is deployed on Render.

Joydeep has implemented an AI chatbot for his portfolio. The chatbot uses a React frontend and a Node.js/Express backend connected to the Groq API. The backend is deployed on Render and the portfolio frontend is deployed on Netlify. The chatbot supports user and AI messages, message timestamps, loading states, Markdown rendering and responsive desktop/mobile layouts. The chatbot does not use a database to permanently store conversations; chats are intended to disappear when the page is reloaded. The chatbot API endpoint is hosted through the portfolio backend.

Bharat Vraman is one of Joydeep's frontend projects, focused on presenting Indian temples and travel-related information through a modern web interface. The project is showcased on his portfolio under the project route /project/bharat-vraman. It demonstrates his frontend development, responsive design and UI implementation skills.

Rentease is a frontend-focused React project featuring both client-side and admin-side interfaces. The project demonstrates responsive UI development, modern component architecture and interactive animations using GSAP and Framer Motion. It was designed as a fully responsive web application with a focus on user experience and polished frontend interactions.
Joydeep is pursuing a Master of Computer Applications (MCA) through Amity University. His academic period is 2026–2028. The program is related to computer applications and software engineering.

Joydeep completed his Bachelor of Computer Applications (BCA) from Kazi Nazrul University during 2022–2025. His academic exposure included Full Stack Web Development and Database Management Systems (DBMS), providing a foundation for his current software development work.
Joydeep completed Class 10 in 2020 and Class 12 in 2022 under the CBSE board.

Joydeep's career focus is software and web development, with React.js and frontend engineering as his strongest area. He is also expanding his backend and MERN skills through Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB and REST API development. His longer-term direction is toward becoming a stronger full-stack/MERN developer while continuing to improve frontend architecture, performance, UI/UX and modern web application development.

Joydeep focuses on building clean, maintainable and reusable frontend code. He prefers component-based architecture, responsive layouts, meaningful user interactions and smooth animations. His development process includes API integration, state management, debugging, performance optimization and cross-device testing. He aims to create interfaces that are visually polished while remaining practical, responsive and maintainable.

Joydeep's main technology stack consists of React.js, JavaScript ES6+, TypeScript, HTML5, CSS3, Tailwind CSS, Redux Toolkit, React Router, GSAP, Framer Motion and Lenis on the frontend. His backend working knowledge includes Node.js, Express.js, REST APIs and MongoDB. He also works with Supabase, Groq API and Cloudinary depending on project requirements. His development tools and deployment platforms include Git, GitHub, Vite, VS Code, NPM, Postman, Netlify, Vercel and Render.
